## Phase6 G1 request — eight requirements, design only
The user accepted/released the twelve restricted Phase5 requirements, then authorized **Phase6 G1 planning only**. This PR covers canonical UI-001–008: six pages, CLI/SDK/UI same-core parity, and durable task submission/status/cancellation/errors/logs/charts. **5 MVP + 3 Competition Ready. G1 is PENDING GPT Work independent review; no Phase6 business implementation or runtime/browser test pass is claimed.**

Verified base `main / phase5-baseline / v0.5.0`: `59246f9fd391c1713b6bed65dd22280f4d248493`. Phase5 accepted implementation `1c5a7e62cace7c3e66b7cc7f12fd564cb0013654`; approved archival head `c43b594f2f427e8a7b3614518b84aa00502365f2`; normal merge `36c26911afb47ff68544e4bf64f060504dfdd94d`. PR #8 premerge official dual OS each1158 original ZIPs verified; postmerge clean SDK1158 and original20+4/math91 passed. Published evidence ZIP499154943 bytes SHA256 `5eb3a1165ae489d004e24dfd6c183878bb529e8b55ceb8c21f3418485f0ce79b`. Old tags retained. These are **P5 prerequisite/regression evidence, not P6 product tests**.

## Review material
Entry: [docs/audits/phase-6/REVIEW_PACKAGE.md](https://github.com/wwooyy429/Alpha-Quant-Research-Platform-AQRP-/blob/f7a1a68c5f747090f8c8a0e934f2fea859aec998/docs/audits/phase-6/REVIEW_PACKAGE.md).
- AUTHORIZATION / PHASE5_RELEASE_RECEIPT / STATUS / FROZEN_INPUTS: actual user scope, released base and4738 protected files.
- REQUIREMENTS_SNAPSHOT / REQUIREMENTS_TRACEABILITY / PLAN / SCOPE_AND_DEPENDENCIES: all8 canonical items and stages.
- INTERFACE_DRAFT / PAGE_SPECIFICATIONS: shared typed request builders and existing P3/P4/P5 services, exact FactorRef/config/data identity, source-bound immutable artifacts; six real page capabilities required after implementation.
- TASK_AND_RECOVERY_CONTRACT: fixed SQLite allocation/claim + unique idempotency key; shared P3 family budget root; trusted preallocated TaskContext/run-slot binding; safe cancellation at stage/atomic-transaction boundaries; ambiguous committed state fails closed; no duplicate work after lost mapping.
- MATH_AND_COMPARISON_CONTRACT / GOLDEN_CANDIDATES / reference_check: explicit presentation-only exactness and independently specified literal answers.32 design groups passed Codex stdlib reference checks; **not independent G1, product or browser tests**.
- DEPENDENCY_AND_COMPATIBILITY_PLAN: Streamlit1.66.1/Plotly7.1.0 metadata candidates; pinned Python3.13.16; Windows51/Linux50 packages resolved while preserving all core versions. Separate extension-only locks contain29 extras, no core hash broadening. No UI installation or active root-lock/approved-runtime change this round; actual install/import/browser compatibility remains to verify after authorization.
- TEST_AND_EVIDENCE_PLAN / OPEN_QUESTIONS / validation/: real core services, concurrency/crash/cancel/failure, exact input/config and independent result projections across CLI/SDK/Streamlit; AppTest separate from actual browser evidence; full SDK/dualOS original ZIP identities/digests/member/wheel/environment/terminal provenance and original failures retained.

## Actual checks and scope
Read-only static package check PASS at inherited P5 code (12 requirements,69 modules,3444 original protected files). All4738 baseline files outside seven governance-status documents remain byte-identical. Source/tests/tools/workflow/build/core lock/scanner/catalog/P5 evidence unchanged. No src/aqrp/ui implementation exists. Candidate designs, metadata locks and reference model are in docs only.32 reference groups PASS, secret scan PASS and staged diff check PASS. Any automatic CI on this plan commit exercises the **inherited P5 suite**; it does not prove UI implementation.

## Review focus / gates
Independently check all8 requirements; task crash/ownership/idempotency plus shared experiment family accounting; cancellation and committed financial unknown states; no UI financial algorithm/hidden preprocessing; exact Ref/config/source and legal-but-wrong UUID refusal; immutable manifest and path boundaries; precise comparison whitelists; candidate dependency/environment proof and old-version limitations; true browser evidence plan. Extend literal/boundary cases independently and report the exact40 SHA, methods, findings and PLAN PASS/BLOCKED. Never review a drifting HEAD.

WI-R2-001/002 and real Windows isolation remain **DEFERRED / NOT VERIFIED** until separately authorized final-integrated-SHA real validation. Formal Test not run, financial approval NONE, complete historical host NOT VERIFIED beyond accepted package/lock/oldRef/result replay. Original failures retained. No account/ACL/service/scheduler change, deployment/live trading/formal Test/financial approval; no Phase6 implementation, merge, tag, release or P7 authorization. G1 PASS would still require separate human implementation authorization.
